root_cause.trajectory_summary: The agent anonymized three PDFs (paper1/2/3) using a PyMuPDF-based script (/root/redact.py) that redacts author names, affiliations, emails, arXiv IDs, venue strings, DOIs, and identifying grant/acknowledgement text on all pages before the References section, while leaving References pages byte-identical to preserve permitted self-citations. It iteratively surfaced residual leaks: paper1 arXiv banner fragments "[eess.AS]" and "30 Sep 2025" (turn 14), paper3 line-broken ARO grant "W911NF-23-2-0224" (turn 15), and after re-running a stray "and ARO" fragment (turn 18-19). After adding all patterns and re-running (turn 20), a comprehensive regex leak scan across pre-references pages returned CLEAN for all three papers. Retention was 99.7% / 98.5% / 99.0%, page counts preserved, and References sections verified byte-identical to originals (turn 22). Output files present at /root/redacted/paper{1,2,3}.pdf with reasonable sizes.

what_worked.item: Turn 16: Re-ran redact.py with tightened patterns; all three papers passed built-in verification (page counts preserved, ≥98.5% text retention).
Turn 17: Regex leak scan on pre-references pages returned CLEAN for paper1 and paper2 against a comprehensive list of author names, affiliations, emails, arXiv IDs, venue, DOI, and grant numbers.

Turn 18: Correctly diagnosed the remaining "ARO" fragment by inspecting context: "was supported in part by
and ARO
-23-2-
." showed the residual token was "and ARO".
Turn 20: After adding the "and ARO" pattern and re-running, the leak scan reports "✓ CLEAN" for all three papers including paper3.

Turn 22: Verified References sections are byte-identical between original and redacted files (orig=40188/6487/15069, identical=True), fulfilling the "self-citations OK if other author info redacted" instruction.
Turn 22: Confirmed all three output files exist at /root/redacted/ with expected sizes (6.2MB, 292KB, 1.27MB), matching the required output paths.

root_cause.outcome_assessment: The final leak scan is clean for all three papers, References sections are byte-identical (preserving self-citations as instructed), page counts and retention are preserved, and the outputs are saved to the required /root/redacted/paper{1,2,3}.pdf paths.
